title: Gate D Consultation Response Schema
description: Defines the required structure of the response returned to the therapist.

request_summary.description: A brief summary of the therapist's consultation request.

relevant_official_entries.description: Established, official clinical concepts related to the context.

retrieved_evidence.description: Evidence from verified knowledge bases supporting the possibilities.

possible_interpretations.description: Potential ways to view the context (must be presented as possibilities).

alternative_interpretations.description: Contrasting or alternate possibilities to consider.

uncertainties.description: Explicit statements about what is uncertain or unknown.

missing_information.description: Gaps in the context that would be helpful to fill.

optional_reflection_questions.description: Questions the therapist might ask themselves or the patient.

optional_reviewed_exercises.description: Pre-reviewed exercises that might be relevant.

therapist_decision_required.description: Indicates that the therapist must actively acknowledge or decide on the generated insights.

audit_metadata.description: Metadata for tracking and auditing this response.
